corrections.reason: Classical Ge'ez 3rd person masculine plural pronominal suffix on 'እግዚእ' is 'እግዚኦሙ' (their Lord), which matches the 7th-order 'ኦ' printed in the image.
The printed Ge'ez plural form is 'ሕዛቢሆሙ' with 4th-order 'ዛ' (shorter left leg), not 1st-order 'ዘ'.
In line 5 the image clearly prints 'አሕዛቢሆሙ' (with initial 'አ' and 4th-order 'ዛ').
Ge'ez construct state before 'እዴከ' is 'ወርዐተ' (1st-order 'ተ'), matching both the parallel 'ሥርዐተ ፡ እዴከ' in line 10 and the printed glyph.
